## Disposition

Accept scoped partial results for planar valuation covariograms, target 30000630 / OWR-1394-006. The arbitrary-body determination target remains unresolved after 5/5 approaches. No sixth route, full-target proof or counterexample, novelty claim or worldwide-openness certificate is added.

The non-even mixed-area classification retains its classical continuity, homogeneous decomposition, volume and mixed-area classification dependencies; their original proofs were not all fully inspected or independently re-proved. Strong strictness over all nonempty compact convex sets differs from body-strict monotonicity. Source normalization observations concern only inspected arXiv:1307.1529v2, not the uninspected publisher text. Analytic determination requires BOTH competitors analytic and positively curved. The smooth switching pair has EXACT uniform boundary-collar perimeter-covariogram equality only, with no full interior equality claim. Two-scale inversion requires genuinely additional dilated-body data and alpha > 0, t > 0, t != 1.

The accepted proof-detail patch preserves monotonicity in Euler normalization, including the empty-set comparison, and makes the exact local body-germ equality, simultaneous compactness localization, reflection and finite-cover collar argument explicit.

## Current mathematics and fresh verification

Fifteen selected accepted inputs are byte-preserved: all six current authored files, full audit, exact correction patch, acceptance, independent checker, and public source/path-free historical verification metadata. The full superseded report is excluded. No third-party source bodies, datasets, private sources, private coordination or identifying metadata for excluded private material are included. Public source titles, URLs, PDF hashes/sizes and retrieval/inspection history are historical evidence only.

Every normal/-O/-OO run uses -I -S -B, actual UID=EUID=1000, 0444 files and 0555 directories. Positive replay fixes all 61 original checks (including 16 invalid-input checks) and 54 independent checks. Twelve intended source mutations per mode are separate from publication controls: nine finite-mathematics mutations and three input-domain mutations. Every intended error type/message and entire raw child output is fixed; arbitrary failure, empty/skipped suites and PASS-only output do not qualify.

Every mode-specific stdout/stderr byte and recursive JSON type must match, with no normalization. Each mode passes 69 integrity negatives, 69 schema/scope negatives and 57 exact-comparator negatives. There are 56 whole-packet physical EACCES denials plus 26 mathematical-harness denials. The full hostile-import baseline matches the clean baseline exactly and no startup/import sentinel is created. Whole-packet and protected-mathematics before/after hashes agree.

Finite regressions do not prove the geometric arguments or external theorems. The exact rational-square-root helper intentionally rejects nonsquare discriminants and is not a numerical reconstruction package. CPython 3.12.14 and its standard library are explicitly trusted, not authenticated here; other runtimes must still match the complete raw-output contracts. Read-only Unix modes are an accidental-write barrier, not kernel immutability or protection against intentional owner chmod.

The fixed external bootstrap binds all delivered files, including acceptance, historical and pre-seal receipts, and raw references. Final external receipts remain outside the delivered inventory to avoid circular hashes. NOT_RUN: excluded original-report replay, old audit-harness replay, historical patch application, source-body replay, new source search, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification. Fresh strict publication testing uses guard_checks.py. Public reproduction from the exact additive diff at a different path reproduces every final full-control output byte in all three modes.

## Scope and independent trust pins

This draft adds exactly 52 files (668,496 bytes) under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000630. No QUEUE or unrelated changes. Base commit: 6ca1e663ab556636a3c2a9b67a96274ef95e8bab. Base tree: a675bbb4eb340ad8a83943d490404c5f9585c0e1. Intended branch: audit/planar-valuation-covariograms-30000630-partial.

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py against this independent SHA-256 before execution and retain the authenticated copy outside the packet. Set packet files to 0444 and directories to 0555, then use actual UID=EUID=1000:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

No private source or accepted-audit archive is required.
